points.title: TX byte accepted
points.condition: i_tx_valid=1 and o_tx_ready=1 at an edge with i_rst_n=1 (acceptance edge)

points.title: TX data 0x00 accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data=8'h00

points.title: TX data 0xFF accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data=8'hFF

points.title: TX data 0x55 or 0xAA accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with i_tx_data equal to 8'h55 or 8'hAA

points.title: TX back-to-back acceptance at E0+10N
points.condition: Acceptance edge where o_tx_ready was 0 at the previous edge (accept at the first cycle ready is 1 after a frame)

points.title: TX back-to-back chain of 3 or more frames
points.condition: Back-to-back acceptance that follows at least two earlier consecutive back-to-back acceptances

points.title: TX acceptance after a short idle gap
points.condition: Acceptance edge after 1 to 3 idle ready cycles without valid

points.title: TX acceptance after a long idle gap
points.condition: Acceptance edge after at least 20 idle ready cycles without valid

points.title: TX offer withdrawn while busy
points.condition: o_tx_ready=0, i_tx_valid was 1 at the previous edge and is 0 now

points.title: TX offer held through back-pressure then accepted
points.condition: Acceptance edge with o_tx_ready 0 at the previous edge and i_tx_valid 1 at the previous edge

points.title: TX i_tx_data changes during a frame
points.condition: o_tx_ready=0 and i_tx_data differs from its value at the previous edge

points.title: TX frame finished, transmitter idle
points.condition: o_tx_ready=1 with it 0 at the previous edge and i_tx_valid=0 (no immediate next byte)

points.title: Reset asserted mid transmit frame
points.condition: First edge with i_rst_n=1 after a reset period that was seen at an edge while o_tx_ready had been 0 at the previous edge

points.title: Reset asserted mid receive frame
points.condition: First edge after reset release, with reset having been seen at an edge while the receiver model was mid frame

points.title: Reset asserted while a byte is held
points.condition: First edge after reset release, with reset seen at an edge when o_rx_valid had been 1 at the previous edge

points.title: TX byte accepted at first edge after release
points.condition: First edge with i_rst_n=1 after reset (previous edge in reset) with i_tx_valid=1 (acceptance R1)

points.title: i_rxd low at reset release
points.condition: First edge with i_rst_n=1 after reset with i_rxd=0

points.title: RX start bit detected
points.condition: Model idle, previous synchronised sample 1 and current synchronised sample 0

points.title: Start-bit glitch rejected
points.condition: At edge T0+H the synchronised sample is 1 (glitch)

points.title: Glitch of one low sample
points.condition: Glitch rejected where the line was already high at T0+1

points.title: Glitch of maximum length H low samples
points.condition: Glitch rejected where all samples T0 to T0+H-1 were low

points.title: Start pulse of H+1 low samples accepted
points.condition: At T0+H+1 the sample is 1 while all samples T0..T0+H were 0 and the frame was confirmed

points.title: New start right after glitch
points.condition: Start condition detected at the edge right after a glitch rejection (T0+H+1)

points.title: Delivery into empty holding register
points.condition: Model delivery edge V with o_rx_valid=0

points.title: Delivery edge with take at V (no overrun)
points.condition: Model delivery edge V with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=1

points.title: Overrun drop at delivery edge
points.condition: Model delivery edge V with o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready=0

points.title: Frame error delivered into empty register
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=0 and stop sample 0

points.title: Frame error byte dropped by overrun
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=1, i_rx_ready=0 and stop sample 0

points.title: Frame error with take at V
points.condition: Delivery edge with o_rx_valid=1, i_rx_ready=1 and stop sample 0

points.title: Back-to-back RX: start at M+1
points.condition: Start condition detected at the edge right after the stop sample edge

points.title: Loaded byte 0x00 or 0xFF without frame error
points.condition: Cycle after a load (delivery into empty or with take) with o_rx_valid=1, o_rx_frame_err=0 and o_rx_data 8'h00 or 8'hFF

points.title: Loaded byte 0x55 or 0xAA
points.condition: Cycle after a load with o_rx_valid=1 and o_rx_data 8'h55 or 8'hAA

points.title: Consumer take outside a delivery edge
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1, i_rx_ready=1 and not a model delivery edge

points.title: Held byte stable with i_rx_ready low
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1, i_rx_ready=0 and not a model delivery edge

points.title: i_rx_ready high with empty register
points.condition: o_rx_valid=0, i_rx_ready=1 and not a delivery edge

points.title: Three or more consecutive overrun drops
points.condition: Overrun drop at delivery after at least two earlier consecutive drops with no non-drop delivery between

points.title: i_rx_ready toggles while a byte is held
points.condition: o_rx_valid=1 and i_rx_ready differs from its value at the previous edge

points.title: Break: line low for 12 bit periods
points.condition: Synchronised line has been 0 for exactly 12*N consecutive edges

points.title: Delivery while transmitter is busy (full duplex)
points.condition: Model delivery edge with o_tx_ready=0

points.title: TX acceptance while receiver is mid frame (full duplex)
points.condition: Acceptance edge while the receiver model is busy receiving a frame
